claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release is v3.263.0 released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L134 lists v3.261.0 released 2026-09-02 as of 2026-09-21).
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.3 released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L135 lists v1.16.1, 2026-09-02).
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.270.0 released 2026-09-17 (the at-a-glance table at L136 lists v2.268.0, 2026-09-02).
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16 released 2026-09-08 (the at-a-glance table at L139 still lists v0.46.1).
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0 released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1 released 2026-09-15 (the at-a-glance table at L142 still lists v2.4.0).
The latest OpenTofu release is v1.12.6 released 2026-08-19.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k, measured 2026-09-21.
Among dedicated IaC tools Terraform is the most-starred, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane; Kubernetes leads the broader ecosystem.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources; Enterprise is custom contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month; Terraform Enterprise is custom priced.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
